summary: The single declaration of the work-item size vocabulary (CD-0229 D4). The versioned decision model sets one size per sized work item; the size selects how much ceremony the work walks, never whether its obligation band applies. Sizes are listed from least to most ceremony. Every projection is derived from this file: the generated Go constants, the work_size_assessments.size_class CHECK, and the agent schema enum.
